target.title: fix(discord): isolate voice connections and close auto-join race
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw can run multiple Discord bot accounts in one guild, but `@discordjs/voice` stores connections by `(group, guildId)` and defaults every caller to the same `default` group. One account can therefore reuse or destroy another account's voice connection. Auto-join can also miss startup when the Discord gateway is already READY before the voice listener is registered.

## Why This Change Was Made

The connection owner now supplies a stable `openclaw:<accountId>` group for lookup, join, and cleanup. The gateway lifecycle also checks its initial readiness after taking ownership of voice cleanup. This closes the ordering race directly, keeps failure cleanup symmetric, and removes the earlier 6-, 8-, and 75-second timing workarounds.

## User Impact

Discord accounts sharing a guild keep independent voice connections. Configured voice auto-join starts whether readiness happened just before listener registration or arrives later through READY/RESUMED. No configuration or command changes are required.

## Evidence

- Direct `@discordjs/voice` 0.19.2 source inspection confirmed its process-global registry is keyed by guild plus caller-provided group and defaults to `default`.
- Fresh Blacksmith Testbox run passed 183 Discord voice/provider/lifecycle tests, including two account managers targeting the same guild, an already-ready gateway, and cleanup after later startup failure: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28755208528
- Exact changed-surface gate passed after the final rebase: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28755904771
- Fresh Codex autoreview caught the pre-lifecycle cleanup gap; the lifecycle-owned correction rerun was clean with no actionable issues, confidence 0.96.
- Exact-head hosted CI passed at `5802e2a8b244fa6f932507731767983a741202c5`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28756233240
- The current maintainer host has no configured multi-account Discord voice setup, so live two-account proof is unavailable; the regression tests exercise the dependency's exact registry and lifecycle contracts.

## Implementation

- Scope every voice connection operation by account ID.
- Start auto-join when an already-connected gateway enters lifecycle ownership.
- Preserve READY and RESUMED listeners for later reconnects.
- Remove all timer-based startup retries.

Release-note context and contributor credit are preserved here; the thanked changelog bullet is queued with the final batch to avoid active-main ordering races.
